eight-ball-product-shot.png.title: 8-Ball Product Shot
eight-ball-product-shot.png.about: Cycles hero still built entirely by a headless Python script: procedural equirect decal for the 8, clear-coated resin, felt with sheen and micro bump, walnut rail, area-light studio and 85 mm shallow depth of field.
eight-ball-product-shot.png.prompt: Write a Blender Python script that builds a pool-table product shot of an 8-ball from scratch: generate the white disc and 8 as a texture with numpy, clear-coat resin material, green felt with sheen, two out-of-focus balls behind, warm overhead area light, 85 mm camera with shallow DOF, and render with Cycles.

eight-ball-turntable.mp4.title: 8-Ball Turntable
eight-ball-turntable.mp4.about: The same scene as a 4-second EEVEE turntable: the camera orbits on a keyframed empty, frames render headless and ffmpeg stitches them into H.264.
eight-ball-turntable.mp4.prompt: Extend the Blender script with a 120-frame EEVEE turntable: parent the camera to an empty, keyframe a linear 360 degree spin, render PNG frames headless and encode them to MP4 with ffmpeg.

low-poly-island.png.title: Low-Poly Island
low-poly-island.png.about: Procedural diorama from one headless Blender script: fBm terrain with a noisy coast mask, per-face colours by height and slope, faceted translucent water, trees, rocks, a lighthouse and clouds, rendered in Cycles.
low-poly-island.png.prompt: Write a Blender Python script that generates a low-poly island from noise: jittered triangle grid, falloff mask for the coast, flat-shaded faces coloured by height and slope (sand, grass, forest, rock, snow), faceted see-through water, scattered low-poly trees and rocks, a striped lighthouse and puffy clouds. Render a three-quarter view in Cycles.

low-poly-island-turntable.mp4.title: Island Turntable
low-poly-island-turntable.mp4.about: Six-second EEVEE orbit of the same island: camera on a keyframed empty, frames rendered headless and stitched with ffmpeg.
low-poly-island-turntable.mp4.prompt: Add a 180-frame EEVEE turntable of the island to the script and encode it to MP4 with ffmpeg.
